All Might's last fight was broadcast live, and the image of him thin and wounded with his fist raised is everywhere: on screens, on walls, on schoolbags. Hero society is shaken. Talk shows ask who will stop the next villain, agencies add shifts, top heroes are pressed for public statements, and Endeavor, the highest-ranked active hero, is judged daily and found wanting. The press turns on U.A. Academy over the camp raid and the kidnapping, and parents ask whether any school can keep students safe. Villains notice the gap first: petty crime and copycat attacks rise, small gangs test neighborhoods that All Might's name once kept quiet, and the League of Villains' name spreads through the underworld.
